params.name: event_id
params.description:
This path parameters specifies the unique identifier for the eBay event being retrieved.

Use the getEvents method to retrieve event IDs.

items.docs:
This method retrieves the details for an eBay event. The result set contains detailed information associated with the specified event ID, such as applicable coupons, start and end dates, and event terms.

Restrictions

This method can return a maximum of 10,000 items. For a list of supported sites and other restrictions, see API Restrictions.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of items, from the current result set, returned on a single page.

Default: 20

Maximum Value: 100

params.name: offset
params.description:
The number of items that will be skipped in the result set. This is used with the limit field to control the pagination of the output.

For example, if the offset is set to 0 and the limit is set to 10, the method will retrieve items 1 through 10 from the list of items returned. If the offset is set to 10 and the limit is set to 10, the method will retrieve items 11 through 20 from the list of items returned.

Default: 0

items.docs:
This method returns paginated results containing all eBay events for the specified marketplace.

Restrictions

This method can return a maximum of 10,000 items. For a list of supported sites and other restrictions, see API Restrictions.
